name: Tostones (Fried Plantains)
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
steps: Heat oil in a frying pan over low heat.
Peel plantain, and cut it horizontally or in circular slices.
Add plantains to frying pan and fry on both sides for about 1 minute or until golden brown.

culture.text: Tostones are twice-fried plantain slices commonly found in Latin American cuisine and Caribbean cuisine.
